import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify potential drivers using t-test and AUC
    t_stats = []
    auc_scores = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            continue  # Skip clinical features for now
        x = feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)]
        y = feats.y
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0], equal_var=False)
        t_stats.append(abs(t_stat))
        auc_scores.append(0.5 + 0.5 * (np.corrcoef(x, y)[0,1] if np.std(x) > 1e-8 else 0))

    # Select top features by t-statistic
    top_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:10]
    candidates = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    filtered_candidates = []
    for fid in candidates:
        x = feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)]
        is_unique = True
        for existing_fid in filtered_candidates:
            y = feats.x[:, feats.column(existing_fid)]
            corr = np.corrcoef(x, y)[0,1] if np.std(x) > 1e-8 and np.std(y) > 1e-8 else 0
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                is_unique = False
                break
        if is_unique:
            filtered_candidates.append(fid)
    
    # Use only top 3 as drivers to avoid overfitting
    drivers = tuple(filtered_candidates[:3])
    
    # For logistic regression, include all relevant features
    columns = tuple(filtered_candidates)
    
    # Product terms: create interactions between top drivers
    products = []
    for i, d1 in enumerate(drivers):
        for j, d2 in enumerate(drivers[i+1:], i+1):
            products.append((d1, d2))
    
    # Loadings: weights based on t-statistics
    loadings = {}
    for fid in columns:
        i = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, i]
        y = feats.y
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0], equal_var=False)
        loadings[fid] = abs(t_stat)
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
